nodes.description: uint256 public zNFTValue; aggregated NFT value written only by performUpkeep and the constructor
uint32 public cpERC20TokenPriceUSD = 3; price multiplier freely writable by setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD
uint32 public soldNFTCnt = 109; used as divisor in performUpkeep and freely writable by setSoldNFTCnt
uint16 public dateDay = 3; day-of-month trigger compared against block.timestamp-derived day
uint16 public dateHour = 21; hour trigger compared against block.timestamp-derived hour
uint16 public dateMin = 1; minute trigger compared against block.timestamp-derived minute
constructor() initializes zNFTValue to 0
setSoldNFTCnt(uint32) external, unguarded setter for soldNFTCnt
setCPERC20TokenPriceUSD(uint32) external, unguarded setter for cpERC20TokenPriceUSD
setDateDay(uint16) external with only a <=31 bound check, no access control
setDateHour(uint16) external with only a <24 bound check, no access control
setDateMin(uint16) external with only a <60 bound check, no access control
checkUpkeep(bytes) external view; parses block.timestamp and returns upkeepNeeded when parsed day/hour/minute match the stored trigger
performUpkeep(bytes) external; writes zNFTValue = (20000 / soldNFTCnt) * cpERC20TokenPriceUSD
isLeapYear(uint16) public pure; leap-year predicate used by calendar helpers
leapYearsBefore(uint256) public pure; counts leap years before a given year
getDaysInMonth(uint8,uint16) public pure; returns days in a month, delegating to isLeapYear for February
parseTimestamp(uint256) internal pure; converts a UNIX timestamp into a _DateTime struct
getYear(uint256) public pure; derives the year from a timestamp using leap-year accounting
getMonth(uint256) public pure; returns parseTimestamp(timestamp).month
getDay(uint256) public pure; returns parseTimestamp(timestamp).day
getHour(uint256) public pure; returns (timestamp / 60 / 60) % 24
getMinute(uint256) public pure; returns (timestamp / 60) % 60
getSecond(uint256) public pure; returns timestamp % 60
getWeekday(uint256) public pure; returns (timestamp / DAY_IN_SECONDS + 4) % 7
block.timestamp: miner/validator-influenced time source driving the keeper trigger decision
Arithmetic: 20000 / soldNFTCnt in performUpkeep reverts on division by zero when soldNFTCnt == 0 and truncates toward zero otherwise
Arithmetic: (20000 / soldNFTCnt) * cpERC20TokenPriceUSD in performUpkeep; attacker-controlled multiplier scales the stored value
Timestamp dependency: checkUpkeep compares block.timestamp-derived day/hour/minute against dateDay/dateHour/dateMin
Missing access control: every set* external function is callable by anyone, allowing arbitrary price, sold-count and trigger-time manipulation

_min: new dateMin value supplied to setDateMin

year: year tested for leap-ness in isLeapYear
year: upper bound year used in leapYearsBefore
month: month index (1-12) used by getDaysInMonth
year: year used by getDaysInMonth for February length
timestamp: UNIX timestamp decomposed into a _DateTime struct
timestamp: UNIX timestamp converted to a year by getYear
timestamp: UNIX timestamp converted to a month by getMonth
timestamp: UNIX timestamp converted to a day by getDay

timestamp: UNIX timestamp converted to a second by getSecond

performData: bytes memory return of checkUpkeep assigned from checkData
dt: _DateTime memory being populated by parseTimestamp
secondsAccountedFor: accumulator of seconds consumed while walking years/months/days
buf: temporary leap-year count used in parseTimestamp year arithmetic
i: uint8 loop counter iterating months and days in parseTimestamp
secondsAccountedFor: accumulator used to back off the estimated year in getYear
year: uint16 candidate year adjusted in the while loop of getYear
numLeapYears: leap years between ORIGIN_YEAR and the candidate year in getYear
